desc:
🐾 MY PET HOTEL! 🏨
Build and run your very own pet hotel! Check guests in, tuck their pets into cozy rooms, clean up their messes, and grow from a tiny lobby into a 5-star empire.

🛏️ Unlock rooms + upgrade them with food bowls, auto-feeders & wallpaper
⭐ Earn reviews: a higher rating attracts RARER pets
🐾 Host all 20 species to complete your Pet Guestbook, with a new Pet of the Day every day!
🦊 Unbox pets of your own and care for them daily
🧹 Hire a full staff, then earn cash while you're OFFLINE!
🛗 Grow to 4 floors: VIP Suites, the Serenity Spa and the Royal Penthouse
🏨 Visit your friends' hotels, rate them and leave a tip
⏰ Rush Hour every 15 minutes: double tips + Golden Guests!
🎨 Paint your hotel, unbox pet trails, claim 14 days of daily rewards!

💬 Join the group for update news, sneak peeks & community events!
👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite to support our updates!
